techStack: Express 5.2.1 (ESM, TypeScript ~6.0.2) — route matching order is first-match-wins, identical to Express 4
Vitest 4.x + supertest for integration tests against the live Express app instance
Zod 4.x — custom `validate(schema)` middleware merges req.params+req.query (GET) into req.validated before the handler runs
better-sqlite3 (in-memory for tests) — seeded via runMigrations()+seed() in beforeAll
ESM-only project (`"type": "module"`) — no CommonJS require; use import/export throughout
Routes mounted in app.ts: `app.use('/api/products', apiProductRoutes)` with no auth middleware on this prefix
features: GET /api/products/:id — validate(productIdSchema) → productController.getById → productService.getProductById; returns full product JSON or 404 via errorHandler
GET /api/products/compare — validate(compareQuerySchema) → compareController.compare → compareService.getComparison; returns { products, count }
compareService.getComparison enforces min 2, max 3 IDs and no duplicates; throws ValidationError for violations
GET /products/ (auth-gated, separate productRoutes router) must not be affected by this change
/:id is currently registered before /compare — /compare is unreachable; the bug is entirely in route declaration order
Neither the controllers, services, schemas, nor middleware need to change — only route registration order
architecture: Layering: routes → controllers → services → db/client (better-sqlite3 singleton)
app.ts assembles middleware stack: requestId → rateLimiter → cors → json body parser → health → productRoutes → apiProductRoutes → favouriteRoutes → 404 → errorHandler
apiProductRoutes.ts is a standalone Express Router mounted at /api/products in app.ts
Static route segments (/compare) must be declared before parameterised segments (/:id) within the same router
errorHandler (4-arg signature) is registered last and handles AppError subclasses (ValidationError→400, ProductNotFoundError→404, etc.)
validate middleware is applied per-route inline; no global validation
edgeCases: After fix: literal string 'compare' in URL path hits /compare route (not /:id) — compareQuerySchema requires ids param, so missing ids returns 400 (not 404)
ids omitted entirely → compareQuerySchema rejects → 400 (satisfies requirement 2)
ids=1 (single ID) → compareQuerySchema min(2) rejects → 400 (satisfies requirement 2)
ids=1,2 (two IDs) → 200 with products.length===2, count===2 (satisfies requirement 1)
ids=1,2,3 (three IDs) → valid; compareService accepts up to 3; routing fix must not break this
ids with whitespace (e.g. '1, 2') → transform trims each segment; treated as valid ['1','2']
Duplicate IDs (e.g. ids=1,1) → schema passes but compareService throws ValidationError → error response (not 200)
Valid numeric /:id after fix → still matches /:id route; getById returns product (satisfies requirement 4)
Non-existent numeric /:id after fix → getById calls next(ProductNotFoundError) → errorHandler returns 404 (satisfies requirement 5)

tasks.requirement: Requirements 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 — move /compare route registration above /:id so Express matches the static segment first; this makes GET /api/products/compare reachable (requirements 1–3) while leaving GET /api/products/:id behaviour unchanged (requirements 4–5); only apiProductRoutes.ts is modified (requirement 6)
tasks.description: In src/routes/apiProductRoutes.ts, move the `router.get('/compare', validate(compareQuerySchema), compare)` declaration to appear before `router.get('/:id', validate(productIdSchema), getById)`. No other changes to any file.
